# Origin-remaining (22 tools)

These slugs stay on Origin. This folder is a **placeholder** so the vendor tree is explicit before Holding attaches the full calc-pack zip.

When the zip lands (`calc-pack/` root → `vendor/calc-pack/*`), replace these placeholders with real sources. Do not invent formulas here.

See `catalog.json` for the 11 audio + 11 guitar slugs. Priority tools `speaker-delay` and `fret-position` are **not** listed here.
